observations: Photo 0, 1, 2 show the same used automatic transmission/transaxle assembly sitting in a yard full of other pulled engines and gearboxes.
Torque converter and flex-plate face are visible with bolt pattern, consistent with an automatic transaxle, not a manual gearbox.
A white paper/sticker label is visible near the bellhousing in all three photos but the text on it is too small/blurred to read.
No brand logo, part number, or VIN/casting number is legible in any photo.
Surface has dirt, grease and light surface rust; no fluid pooling or obvious cracks seen in the housing.
A person in a green shirt is visible in the background in photo 0 and 1, suggesting an open-air used-parts market ('tokunbo' yard).
No video, no bench-spin test, no dipstick/fluid check, and no shipping/packaging shown.

identity.kind: automatic transmission/transaxle assembly (seller claims Ford Fusion fitment)

claims.evidence: No Ford logo, casting mark, or part-number tag is readable in photo 0, 1, or 2; the white label present is illegible.
No engine-size tag or VIN sticker is legible in any photo; this is only the seller's text claim.

claims.claim: Implied working/good condition (standard for such listings)
claims.evidence: No test video, no fluid check, no spin-test shot provided in any of the 3 photos.

risks.risk: Exact Ford Fusion model year/engine fitment cannot be confirmed, so it may not match the buyer's car.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the part-number/casting tag or OEM label on the case.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used Fusion automatic transaxle, fitment unconfirmed

risks.risk: Transmission could be non-functional (slipping, burnt clutches, internal damage) despite being pulled and sold as a unit.
risks.proof: A video of the unit being spun/tested on a bench or the input shaft turning freely with no grinding noise.

risks.risk: Torque converter could be seized or damaged, common failure point not visible from outside.
risks.proof: Photo/video of torque converter removed and spun, or fluid drained showing no metal debris.

risks.risk: Unknown mileage/history of the donor vehicle; could be from a wrecked or flood vehicle.
risks.proof: Photo of donor vehicle tag, auction sheet, or import paperwork.

risks.risk: Fluid leaks or seal damage not clearly visible due to dirt/grease coating.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seals and the pan gasket after a wipe-down.
risks.if_unproven: priced as seals unverified, possible leak

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the part number/casting tag or OEM sticker on the transmission case.
Video of the transmission being spun or bench-tested to confirm the input shaft turns freely without grinding.
Confirmation (photo) of the exact Ford Fusion model year and engine size this transaxle was pulled from.
Close-up photos of the torque converter and seals after cleaning off surface grime.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a used automatic transmission/transaxle claimed to fit a Ford Fusion, but none of the seller's claims (brand/model fitment, engine size, working condition) can be confirmed from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified-fitment, untested used unit pending the requested proof.
